title: The Eagle and the Cocks
summary: The victorious cock flew to the barn roof to crow his triumph, attracting an eagle that carried him away, leaving the defeated cock to inherit the flock....
full_text: The victorious cock flew to the barn roof to crow his triumph, attracting an eagle that carried him away, leaving the defeated cock to inherit the flock.
moral: Boastful triumph attracts destruction, while modest silence endures.
